The first arrow is pi(a|s), the stationary policy mass from F1; the second is p(t,rho|s,a), the joint reward-transition mass from F1 and the local MDP definition. Its direction is from the admissible current state/action to the next state/reward, preserving their possible dependence. A fixed upper route contributes pi(a|s)p(t,rho|s,a), not the whole mixed mass.

Substitute B={(t,rho)} into the Statement formula at line 48. The indicator selects exactly this pair in the inner finite sum, yielding K_pi((s,eta),{(t,rho)})=sum_a pi(a|s)p(t,rho|s,a). Line 93 explicitly says to sum over actions, so no incorrect equality with one upper route or deterministic commutativity is asserted.
